changes_made.explanation: Removed tasks that were not actually evaluated (the paper is about watermarking text generation, not specific tasks like summarization). Removed duplicate/alternative dataset names. Kept only the core text generation task since the paper focuses on watermarking general text generation.
Consolidated duplicate metric names and normalized to consistent lowercase. Kept the core metrics used for evaluation: perplexity for quality and top-k accuracy for identification performance.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The paper uses watermarking techniques and statistical metrics for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations were automatic using perplexity and accuracy metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on watermarking techniques for LLM-generated text to enable source identification. It's primarily a methods paper with strong technical evaluation using automatic metrics. The extraction was generally good but included some over-interpretation of tasks (the paper evaluates general text generation watermarking, not specific NLG tasks like summarization).
